column1: # One reader's classification (Claude Opus 5.5, ai-risk-model spike, 2026-10-10) of every unflagged judged stretch at cut 188,
# from the stretch's opening words and its judge's note, not from rereading the whole document. Estimated, not measured.
# The chemical/biological query's 12 stretches are not inspected or classified (brief's constraint).
# PARA     says the query's own concept in other words (incl. another source's term for it)
# NBR      a different concept that domain knowledge links to the query: an instance, mechanism, sub-type, or evidence of it
# RELDEF   a glossary entry or definition of a related or paired term
# XREF     a provision the document itself ties to a relevant one: a definition used inside it, an exclusion, a statute's repeat
# FORM     the query's word is there in a form the matcher misses (compound, derivation, tokenizer)
# RANK     direct content holding the query's words, ranked just past the cut
# CTX      peripheral context whose link is the judge's wide reading
